$comment: Layer 4 - claims this repository cannot prove on its own: a physical device, a simulator run, the EAS server-side environment store. Each entry is a written, checked-in statement of what a human observed, with a date, an expiry, and the recipe to observe it again. A governed document points at one with <!-- vt-claim: attested <id> -->. An entry past its budget FAILS the gate, and so does an entry no document references. Device claims are NOT auto-detected from prose: the marker is how such a claim enters the ledger (see scripts/verify/scan.js for why a heuristic was rejected - it produced four false alarms out of six matches on this repo's own docs).

entries.claim: G1 navigation runs on the iPhone 17 simulator, and NFC reports isSupported=true on a physical Pixel 7 under the New Architecture

entries.claim: The Uniwind theme renders on the iPhone 17 simulator: HomeScreen and NfcSpikeScreen both drew, bundle 5.58 MB, tsc 0
The EAS production environment supplies EXPO_PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN and EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY to the build

entries.claim: NFC read, WRITE and read-back all work on physical hardware — iPhone 16 Plus (iOS 26.6) and Pixel 7 (Android 16). A blank tag yields the correct no-id diagnostic on both; a written tag reads back to the correct unit through the app's own parser. The iOS write succeeded under a TAG-only reader session (includeNdefEntitlement false), so the NDEF format entitlement is NOT required to write. LOCKING IS NOT COVERED: makeReadOnly has never been invoked from this codebase. Re-verify by re-running stages 1 and 2 of the script.
entries.attestedBy: repo owner, with device syslog and logcat corroboration recorded in the run log

entries.claim: At iOS AX5 the 200% text ceiling reaches RN's NativeSelectableText branch: the Settings version line (<AppText selectable>) stayed the smallest text on the screen and proportional to its base size, while an uncapped label on the Menu screen at the same setting filled its card. That element is the one with no automated coverage asserting the ceiling reaches it. Re-verify by re-running step 1.6 at iOS AX5.
entries.attestedBy: repo owner, screenshot comparison at the same AX5 setting across two screens
